plumbing.review:
- **[P2] Dependency builds fail on a fresh Docker daemon.** [python_deps.go:255](python_deps.go:255) starts the parser with `--pull=never`, but production never ensures the pinned base exists beforehand. Valid requirements therefore fail before image construction. The acceptance helper masks this by explicitly pulling the base at [python_parser_accept_test.go:333](python_parser_accept_test.go:333). Acquire the pinned `linux/amd64` base after preflight, preserve offline parsing, and add cold-start coverage.

- **Required merge evidence is missing from the supplied artifacts.** The abbreviated [tests.txt:1](tests.txt:1) does not establish real Docker/PyPI success. [README.md:139](README.md:139) requires passing output on the final head; [README.md:145](README.md:145) also identifies the outstanding dependency-policy record and citations.

Otherwise, scope matches the allowlist, all 16 acceptance sources match the ratified plan, and existing test adjustments are narrow. Static review found no additional check weakening, test-specific bypass, unexpected network/host access, secret leakage, or material style issue. I did not rerun tests under the read-only restriction.

VERDICT: changes needed — prepare the pinned base and cover cold starts; provide final-head real-suite evidence and complete the required policy record and citations.
